Gale Calibration.description: After the user personally marks the target and maintains awareness of it, the ability stores a measured amount of chakra crossing prepared seals and formula boundaries as a temporary standard, then reinforces or suppresses only the difference from that standard.
Gale Calibration.origin: An unusual chakra response first triggered during a formative moment.

Gale Calibration.limitation: It affects only chakra crossing prepared seals and formula boundaries; breaking the activation condition ends the effect, and scale, duration, range, precision, and simultaneous targets compete for the same setting-native resource.

Gale Calibration.canon_balance: Begins at the practical scale of a talented local novice, with a ceiling earned through the same mastery, cost, and counterplay expected of comparable powers in this world.

Chakra Affinity Profile.native_rule: The natural affinity is the easiest basic nature to discover, learn, stabilize and refine. It does not automatically grant a mastered jutsu.
Chakra Affinity Profile.off_affinity_rule: Other basic natures remain learnable through sufficient control, instruction and practice. They become proficiencies, not additional natural affinities.
Chakra Affinity Profile.combined_nature_rule: Using two learned basic natures does not create a combined release. A true elemental combination requires the matching Kekkei Genkai, Kekkei Tōta, or another explicitly established canon-valid mechanism.

Chakra Affinity Profile.native_rule: The natural affinity is the easiest basic nature to discover, learn, stabilize and refine. It does not automatically grant a mastered jutsu.
Chakra Affinity Profile.off_affinity_rule: Other basic natures remain learnable through sufficient control, instruction and practice. They become proficiencies, not additional natural affinities.
Chakra Affinity Profile.combined_nature_rule: Using two learned basic natures does not create a combined release. A true elemental combination requires the matching Kekkei Genkai, Kekkei Tōta, or another explicitly established canon-valid mechanism.
